brief:
Israeli-backed Palestinian militias have intensified attacks over the past year against Palestinians displaced in Gaza, Drop Site News reported. The violence has concentrated on families living near the expanding "yellow line," a demarcation tied to Israeli military operations.

The escalating pattern marks a shift in the security landscape within Gaza, where armed groups operating with Israeli backing have targeted vulnerable populations already displaced by conflict.
dek: Over the past year, attacks by Israel-backed Palestinian militias have become increasingly frequent in Gaza, particularly targeting Palestinians living close to the ever expanding “yellow line.”
title: Israeli-backed militias terrorize displaced Palestinians in Gaza
